name: John Quinn
story: John Quinn was named by NIWA as a contact and contributor to the Whatawhata Sustainable Land Management Project during the 2000s. The project combined stream monitoring, erosion and land-use assessment with farm economics to test integrated hill-country catchment management.
Quinn also appears as an author of the 2009 CLUES modelling paper, linking two contemporary but distinct lines of environmental research.
